name: PowerX,Inc.
summary: PowerX, Inc. researches, develops and produces energy storage systems and vessels for transferring power, in BESS, EVCS and Power segments. The BESS business makes the large-scale stationary storage system PowerX Mega Power, and the EVCS business makes, sells and operates the PowerX Hypercharger rapid EV-charging system. Masahiro Ito and Tadahisa Kagimoto founded it in 2021, and it has its headquarters in Minato-ku, Japan.
